hypotheses.reasoning: Sustained volume expansion against trailing mean, dominated by buys, is the earliest market-visible trace of coordinated accumulation; a genuine unique-buyer feature is REFUTED-blocked (tx-level data unavailable free), proxy explicitly declared.

hypotheses.observation_cutoff: features frozen at as_of = first_seen_ts + 3600s (JOIN_OFFSET, locked); outcomes from observations only
hypotheses.baseline: all RESOLVED E-01 candidates with a label for the same horizon/class (survivorship-bias ban: RUGS/DEAD/FLAT/SECURITY-FAILED stay in the cohort)
hypotheses.exclusion_rules: no exclusions beyond engine laws: SECURITY FAIL veto never removed from cohort; missing feature => not in condition stratum (no imputation); illiquid tokens stay IN (liquidity-adjusted variants reported separately)
hypotheses.success_bar: training lift 95% Wilson CI lower bound > 1.0 AND OOS (strictly later weeks) lift CI lower > 1.0 AND stability across time-halves

hypotheses.expected_failure_mode: wash-trading inflates both proxies — discount via security gate + liquidity-adjusted variants
hypotheses.note: RESEARCH HYPOTHESIS — not a trading signal; rank-first law unchanged; no score implied
